### 1. `packages/core/src/account/ops/exchanges/bitget.test.ts`

Source (bitget.ts):
- BASE_URL = "https://api.bitget.com"
- fields: ["api_key", "secret", "passphrase"]
- sign: prehash = timestamp + method + path + (body ?? ""), HMAC-SHA256 Base64
- Headers: ACCESS-KEY, ACCESS-SIGN, ACCESS-TIMESTAMP, ACCESS-PASSPHRASE, Content-Type

Tests needed:
- meta: id="bitget", name="Bitget", fields=["api_key", "secret", "passphrase"]
- sign: produces base64 signature, correct URL, correct headers
- sign: body inclusion changes signature (like OKX test)

### 2. `packages/core/src/account/ops/exchanges/bybit.test.ts`

Source (bybit.ts):
- BASE_URL = "https://api.bybit.com"
- fields: ["api_key", "secret"]
- sign: prehash = timestamp + api_key + recvWindow("5000") + queryString (alphabetically sorted params)
- HMAC-SHA256 Hex
- Headers: X-BAPI-API-KEY, X-BAPI-SIGN, X-BAPI-TIMESTAMP, X-BAPI-RECV-WINDOW, Content-Type

Tests needed:
- meta: id="bybit", name="Bybit", fields=["api_key", "secret"]
- sign: hex signature, correct URL with query params, correct headers
- sign: params are sorted alphabetically in query and signature
- sign: known-value assertion

### 3. `packages/core/src/account/ops/exchanges/gate.test.ts`

Source (gate.ts):
- BASE_URL = "https://api.gateio.ws"
- fields: ["api_key", "secret"]
- sign: hashedBody = SHA512(body ?? ""), prehash = `${method}\n${path}\n${queryString}\n${hashedBody}\n${timestamp}`
- HMAC-SHA512 Hex
- Headers: KEY, SIGN, Timestamp, Content-Type

Tests needed:
- meta: id="gate", name="Gate", fields=["api_key", "secret"]
- sign: hex SHA512 signature, correct URL, correct headers
- sign: body hashing affects signature
- sign: known-value assertion

### 4. `packages/core/src/account/ops/exchanges/kucoin.test.ts`

Source (kucoin.ts):
- BASE_URL = "https://api.kucoin.com"
- fields: ["api_key", "secret", "passphrase"]
- sign: prehash = timestamp + method + path + (body ?? ""), HMAC-SHA256 Base64
- ALSO: passphraseSign = HMAC-SHA256(secret, passphrase) in Base64
- Headers: KC-API-KEY, KC-API-SIGN, KC-API-TIMESTAMP, KC-API-PASSPHRASE (=passphraseSign), KC-API-KEY-VERSION="2", Content-Type

Tests needed:
- meta: id="kucoin", name="KuCoin", fields=["api_key", "secret", "passphrase"]
- sign: base64 signature, correct URL, correct headers
- sign: passphrase is HMAC-signed (not raw passphrase in header)
- sign: known-value assertion

### 5. `packages/core/src/account/ops/exchanges/lighter.test.ts`

Source (lighter.ts):
- BASE_URL = "https://api.lighter.xyz"
- fields: ["api_key", "secret"]
- sign: prehash = timestamp + method + path + (body ?? ""), HMAC-SHA256 Hex
- Headers: X-API-KEY, X-API-SIGNATURE, X-API-TIMESTAMP, Content-Type

Tests needed:
- meta: id="lighter", name="Lighter", fields=["api_key", "secret"]
- sign: hex signature, correct URL, correct headers
- sign: body changes signature
- sign: known-value assertion

**For known-value assertions**, use `createHmac` from "node:crypto" directly in the test to compute the expected value, then assert the exchange's sign() output matches. Example:

```typescript
import { createHmac } from "node:crypto";

it("produces correct known-value signature", () => {
  const credentials = { api_key: "my-key", secret: "my-secret", passphrase: "my-pass" };
  const params = { method: "GET" as const, path: "/test", timestamp: "1700000000000" };
  const result = exchange.sign(credentials, params);
  
  const expected = createHmac("sha256", "my-secret")
    .update("1700000000000GET/test")
    .digest("base64"); // or "hex" depending on exchange
  expect(result.headers["SIGN-HEADER"]).toBe(expected);
});
```

Write all 5 files. Use `vitest` imports. Each file is standalone. Run `cd /Users/lxy/Documents/GitHub/LinXueyuanStdio/viben && npx vitest run packages/core/src/account/ops/exchanges/bitget.test.ts packages/core/src/account/ops/exchanges/bybit.test.ts packages/core/src/account/ops/exchanges/gate.test.ts packages/core/src/account/ops/exchanges/kucoin.test.ts packages/core/src/account/ops/exchanges/lighter.test.ts` to verify all pass.
